articles.title: Lawsuit Blames Texas Abortion Ban for Woman's Death

articles.summary: 得州一名37岁孕妇在孕20周因子痫前期死亡，家属提起诉讼，称得州堕胎禁令导致其死亡；涉及产科急救、孕产妇死亡与堕胎监管政策。

articles.title: Robotic help in high-risk twin pregnancies: Panoramic guidance for a flexible laser scope
articles.excerpt: In Switzerland, around 2,400 children are born as twins every year. When the fetuses share a placenta, they are connected to one another via blood vessels. If the blood circulation becomes unbalanced, this can be life-threatening for both, as too much blood flows from one fetus to the other.
articles.summary: 瑞士每年约2400名双胎出生；共享胎盘的双胎通过血管相连，血流失衡可危及两个胎儿。该报道介绍机器人辅助全景引导用于柔性激光镜，以处理高风险双胎妊娠。
